2025. 4. 17(목)
장중 DRAM 현물가격
6.68K
views
03:48
미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건
일간 메모리 현물가격
[미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건/김제호]
기준: 2025.4.17(목)
◆ DRAM: 제품 평균 +0.4%(12개 상승)
*DDR5 Premium vs. DDR4: +57.1%
→ DDR4 1Gx8-3200 브랜드 칩 위주 견적 문의 발생, 저가 구간 거래 발생. 제품 전반 가격 소폭 상승, 거래량 제한적
Momentum was moderate, with inquiries mainly focused on DDR4 1Gx8-3200 branded chips. There was clear buying activity at lower price points, which slightly drove spot prices upward. However, buyers remained cautious, and actual transaction volumes were limited.
◆ NAND: *금일 현물가 미제공
→ 양측 관망세 유지, 일부 품목 외 제품 전반 수요 약세. eMMC 가격 변동폭 제한적, 거래활동 제한적
eMMC prices remained stable, and overall buying momentum was quiet. Both supply and demand sides maintained a conservative, wait-and-see approach. Only occasional inquiries were made for specific part numbers, while demand for other chips remained weak.
(Source: DRAMeXchange)

JEDEC가 HBM4 표준을 최종 확정. 최대 1.5TB/s 대역폭 및 향상된 전력 효율로 AI 및 HPC 수요 대응 강화
https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/ram/jedec-finalizes-hbm4-memory-standard-with-major-bandwidth-and-efficiency-upgrades

미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건
일간 메모리 현물가격
[미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건/김제호]
기준: 2025.4.21(월)
◆ DRAM: 제품 평균 +0.4%(13개 상승)
*DDR5 Premium vs. DDR4: +57.1%
→ 구매업체 실수요 제품 한정 견적 문의 진행. 일부 제품 외 가격 변동폭 제한적, 거래활동 비교적 약세
Market activity was relatively weak. Buyers issued inquiries based only on actual demand, with a generally cautious approach to procurement. Apart from price increases for chips in key demand capacities, most other chip prices remained stable.
◆ NAND: *N/A(전일 현물가 미제공)
→ 일부 지역 연휴, 양측 관망세 지속. 제품 전반 가격 소폭 하락세, 거래활동 제한적
Due to holidays in certain regions, momentum was quiet. Both supply and demand sides largely maintained a cautious, wait-and-see stance. Although there were sporadic inquiries, price negotiations appeared passive. The market remained stable but with slight downward pressure, and actual transactions were limited.
(Source: DRAMeXchange)

views
03:01
미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건
일간 메모리 현물가격
[미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건/김제호]
기준: 2025.4.22(화)
◆ DRAM: 제품 평균 +0.5%(15개 상승)
*DDR5 Premium vs. DDR4: +57.3%
→ DDR4 8G 브랜드 칩 위주 거래활동 발생. 상대적으로 낮은 가격대에서 강한 매수세 확인, 제품 전반 가격 강세
Momentum was sporadic, with major buying activity focused on DDR4 8G branded chips. There was strong buying support at relatively lower price ranges, and overall price trends remained on the stronger side.
◆ NAND: *금일 현물가 미제공
→ 8G/16G eMMC 대상 소량의 거래 발생, 이외 제품 수요 약세. 제품 전반 가격 변동폭 및 거래활동 제한적
Demand was scattered and mostly concentrated on 8G/16G eMMC. While there were small-volume transactions, overall buying interest remained weak, with limited trading momentum. The market continued to exhibit narrow fluctuations.
(Source: DRAMeXchange)

중국이 미국산 아날로그 칩에 보복 관세를 부과하면서 자동차/산업용 반도체 중심으로 국산화 전환 가속. OmniVision, Smartsens 등 CIS 강자들이 TSMC 난징/Nexchip 등 성숙공정 파운드리에 대규모 주문 집중, 고수익 기반 마련

◆ DRAM: 제품 평균 +0.4%(11개 상승)
*DDR5 Premium vs. DDR4: +58.1%
→ DDR3/4 대상 견적 문의 지속, 일부 용량 제품 가격 상승세 견인. 공장 소극적 가격 협상 기조에 제품 전반 거래활동 제한적
Inquiries for DDR3 and DDR4 continued, driving noticeable price increases for certain chip capacities. Although factories showed interest in following the upward trend and continued to inquire, their pace of bidding remained cautious. As a result, actual transaction volumes were still limited.
◆ NAND: *금일 현물가 미제공
→ eMMC 8G 수요 소폭 증가, 공급업체 TP 유지. 양측 관망세 지속, 제품 전반 거래활동 제한적
There was a slight increase in demand for eMMC 8G, with sporadic inquiries emerging in the lower price range. However, suppliers maintained a firm stance on their quotations, leaving limited overlap between the prices of buyers and sellers. The overall market atmosphere remained heavily in a wait-and-see mode, and transaction outcomes were less than favorable.
(Source: DRAMeXchange)
